claims.claim_text: The indexed James C Parker is linked at high confidence to the official Army record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and official Army bulk record agree on the exact name and a nonshared protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact official name-and-identifier agreement.
claims.temporal_assessment: The records establish wartime Army identity, not a named pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: Protected identifiers are masked publicly; coded Army occupation data are not used as employer evidence.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Lester Parkes record has a protected-identifier conflict that prevents acceptance of the otherwise matching Army name.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army bulk file repeats the matching name, but the protected identifier is also printed for a separate Robert L Miller index row.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting official identifier evidence; no Army identity is accepted.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict must be resolved from the affected personnel files before employment evidence can be attributed safely.
claims.match_notes: Both source rows remain separate. The printed Pfc column shift is preserved, and no coded Army data are transferred.
